query:
SELECT label AS "label!", release AS "release!"
                FROM (
                    SELECT label, release,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY label ORDER BY release) AS rn
                    FROM release_label
                    WHERE label = ANY($1)
                      AND ($2::int IS NULL OR release > $2)
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn <= $3
                ORDER BY label, release
